support.scope: complete saved DEBUG cohort; not full production support

graph_audits.dispersion_definition: 2 * mean(||v - mean(v)||^2) over all eligible members of each scene/band; selection normalization only, not input features
graph_audits.zero_variance_policy: If count exceeds quota: explicit FloatingPointError, no geometry-only fallback. Otherwise retain every available member without FPS selection.

limitations: Feature/space diversity selector is a research rule, not learned CP importance.
Hard selection indices are not differentiable; selected CNN features are.
An edge denotes a message relation, not a vessel or voxel sampling path.
A single local DEBUG update is not accuracy or production performance evidence.
